files.html: //! examples/geno_mirror - Geno's clips and their mirror images, side by side on the symmetric robot. //! //! WHAT YOU ARE LOOKING AT //! //! The robot every training run uses - Geno, built from its own skeleton and mesh and made symmetric, each body its //! partner's mirror image - posed frame by frame by a baked clip, and beside it by the same clip mirrored left for //! right. No physics and no learning: these are the references the trainer embeds, exactly as it reads them. //! //! A mirrored clip is made where the motion is still the capture's: every joint takes its partner's motion, reflected //! across a vertical plane and turned by one fixed correction per joint, and is then copied onto the robot like any //! capture, cut and rested on the floor. On a symmetric body the result is the original's mirror image, body for body //! and sole for sole. Two views ask that question by eye: //! //! * the MIRROR PAIR: the original on one side of the mirror plane, the mirrored clip on the other - each the //! other's reflection, the left hand's motion now the right hand's; //! * REFLECTED BACK: the mirrored clip's skeleton reflected across the plane again and drawn over the original's - //! where the mirror is right, the two skeletons are one. //! //! The panel says the same in numbers, frame by frame: each sole's height in both clips (the mirrored left is the //! original right), and how far the mirrored clip's farthest body lies from where its partner was, reflected. const std = @import("std"); const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const ui = z.ui; const rbt = z.robot; const rmj = z.robot_mjcf; const mjcf = z.mjcf; const codecs = z.codecs; const dance = z.robot_dance; const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const eql = std.mem.eql; const startsWith = std.mem.startsWith; const bufPrint = std.fmt.bufPrint; const Color = zm.Color; const Camera3D = zm.Camera3D; const Vec = zm.Vec; const Mat = zm.Mat; const Quat = zm.Quat; const vec = zm.vec; const float = zm.float; const int = zm.int; const clamp = zm.clamp; const mulMat = zm.mulMat; const qmul = zm.qmul; const quatToMat = zm.quatToMat; const translation = zm.translation; const scaling = zm.scaling; const splat = zm.splat; const rotate = zm.rotate; const length3 = zm.length3; const floatMax = zm.floatMax; const roboto_mono_ttf = @embedFile("roboto_mono_ttf"); /// The four clips of the minute and their mirror images, baked beside each other (`examples/geno_ppo/*.zclip`). const ClipPair = struct { label: []const u8, original: []const u8, mirrored: []const u8 }; const clip_pairs = [_]ClipPair{ .{ .label = "dance", .original = @embedFile("geno_dance_zclip"), .mirrored = @embedFile("geno_dance_mirrored_zclip"), }, .{ .label = "get-up", .original = @embedFile("geno_getup_zclip"), .mirrored = @embedFile("geno_getup_mirrored_zclip"), }, .{ .label = "walk", .original = @embedFile("geno_walk_zclip"), .mirrored = @embedFile("geno_walk_mirrored_zclip"), }, .{ .label = "run", .original = @embedFile("geno_run_zclip"), .mirrored = @embedFile("geno_run_mirrored_zclip"), }, }; /// The page's colours. const Palette = struct { background: Color = .{ .r = 22, .g = 24, .b = 30, .a = 255 }, ground: Color = .{ .r = 74, .g = 80, .b = 92, .a = 255 }, mirror: Color = .{ .r = 150, .g = 160, .b = 185, .a = 255 }, original: Color = .{ .r = 120, .g = 170, .b = 225, .a = 255 }, mirrored: Color = .{ .r = 230, .g = 150, .b = 90, .a = 255 }, sole_down: Color = .{ .r = 110, .g = 200, .b = 130, .a = 255 }, }; /// How the page lays the two clips out. const Layout = struct { /// How close to the mirror plane the original's root comes, so the pair never overlaps. least_gap_m: f32 = 0.45, /// A sole counts as down within this of the floor. down_height_m: f32 = 0.01, /// Joint dots of the skeletons, in metres. joint_radius_m: f32 = 0.018, /// How far the camera's target sits to the pair's left, so the panel does not cover it. view_shift_m: f32 = 0.6, }; /// Which way the page shows the pair. const View = enum(i32) { mirror_pair = 0, reflected_back = 1 }; /// One clip on the robot: its frames and the pose on show. const Posed = struct { clip: dance.Clip, data: rbt.Data, }; /// What one sole is doing on the frame on show. const Sole = struct { /// Its lowest point's height above the floor; negative means through it. height: f32 = 0, /// Where to draw its marker: the foot's own place. at: Vec = vec(0, 0, 0), }; const State = struct { gpa: Allocator, font: z.Font, ui_host: z.UiHost, cam: z.OrbitCamera, cube: z.Mesh, sphere: z.Mesh, transform: [1]Mat, palette: Palette = .{}, layout: Layout = .{}, doc: codecs.xml.Document, robot: mjcf.Robot, imported: rmj.Imported, /// Each body's partner across the body: its `Left` and `Right` swapped, a body on the midline its own. partners: []u32, lowest_points: []f32, original: Posed, mirrored: Posed, /// The clip on show, an index into `clip_pairs`. clip_index: i32 = 0, loaded_clip: i32 = -1, /// How far the pair stands from the mirror plane: the original moved this far along x, the mirrored clip as far /// the other way, so the two stay each other's reflection. offset_m: f32 = 0, /// The frame on show, as a float so the slider can scrub it smoothly. frame: f32 = 0, playing: bool = true, /// Frames a second while playing - the clips' own 60, or slower to study them. rate: f32 = 60.0, view: i32 = @backingInt(View.mirror_pair), follow: bool = true, show_soles: bool = true, original_left: Sole = .{}, original_right: Sole = .{}, mirrored_left: Sole = .{}, mirrored_right: Sole = .{}, /// How far the mirrored clip's farthest body lies from where its partner was in the original, reflected - and /// the most over the whole clip, measured when it loads. frame_gap_m: f32 = 0, clip_gap_m: f32 = 0, }; /// A place across the mirror plane, x = 0 of the robot's z-up world: x to -x. fn acrossTheMirror(place: Vec) Vec { return vec(-place[0], place[1], place[2]); } /// A place of the robot's z-up world where the drawing, y up, puts it: (x, y, z) to (x, z, -y), as `zUpToYUp` turns. fn drawn(place: Vec) Vec { return vec(place[0], place[2], -place[1]); } fn bodyNamed(names: []const []const u8, want: []const u8) ?u32 { for (names, 0..) |name, index| { if (eql(u8, name, want)) { return @intCast(index); } } return null; } /// A body's partner across the body: `Left...` for `Right...` and back, a body on the midline its own. fn partnerOf(names: []const []const u8, body: u32) u32 { const name: []const u8 = names[body]; var swapped: [64]u8 = undefined; const partner_name: []const u8 = if (startsWith(u8, name, "Left")) bufPrint(&swapped, "Right{s}", .{name["Left".len..]}) catch return body else if (startsWith(u8, name, "Right")) bufPrint(&swapped, "Left{s}", .{name["Right".len..]}) catch return body else return body; return bodyNamed(names, partner_name) orelse body; } /// One sole on the posed robot: the lowest point of its foot and its toe, and the foot's place. fn soleOf( s: *const State, data: *const rbt.Data, foot_name: []const u8, toe_name: []const u8, ) Sole { const names: []const []const u8 = s.imported.names; const foot: u32 = bodyNamed(names, foot_name) orelse return .{}; const toe: u32 = bodyNamed(names, toe_name) orelse return .{}; return .{ .height = @min(s.lowest_points[foot], s.lowest_points[toe]), .at = data.body_positions[foot], }; } /// Both clips posed at a frame. fn poseAt(s: *State, frame: usize) void { const model: *const rbt.Model = &s.imported.model; for ([2]*Posed{ &s.original, &s.mirrored }) |posed| { const at: usize = @min(frame, posed.clip.frame_count - 1); @memcpy(posed.data.joint_positions, posed.clip.pose(at)); posed.data.stage = .stale; rbt.kinematics(model, &posed.data); } } /// How far the mirrored clip's farthest body lies from where its partner was in the original, reflected. fn mirrorGap(s: *const State) f32 { var worst: f32 = 0; for (1..s.imported.model.body_count) |body| { const partner: u32 = s.partners[body]; const expected: Vec = acrossTheMirror(s.original.data.body_positions[partner]); worst = @max(worst, length3(s.mirrored.data.body_positions[body] - expected)); } return worst; } /// The frame on show: both clips posed, their soles, and the gap between the mirrored clip and the original's /// reflection. fn showFrame(s: *State, frame: usize) void { poseAt(s, frame); const model: *const rbt.Model = &s.imported.model; rbt.bodyLowestPoints(model, &s.original.data, s.lowest_points); s.original_left = soleOf(s, &s.original.data, "LeftFoot", "LeftToeBase"); s.original_right = soleOf(s, &s.original.data, "RightFoot", "RightToeBase"); rbt.bodyLowestPoints(model, &s.mirrored.data, s.lowest_points); s.mirrored_left = soleOf(s, &s.mirrored.data, "LeftFoot", "LeftToeBase"); s.mirrored_right = soleOf(s, &s.mirrored.data, "RightFoot", "RightToeBase"); s.frame_gap_m = mirrorGap(s); } /// Load the pair at `clip_pairs[index]`: both clips, the offset that keeps the pair apart, and the gap over the clip. fn loadPair(s: *State, index: usize) !void { if (s.loaded_clip >= 0) { s.original.clip.deinit(); s.mirrored.clip.deinit(); } s.original.clip = try dance.Clip.fromBytes(s.gpa, clip_pairs[index].original); s.mirrored.clip = try dance.Clip.fromBytes(s.gpa, clip_pairs[index].mirrored); s.loaded_clip = @intCast(index); // The original's root comes no closer to the plane than `least_gap_m`, and the mirrored clip's no closer from // the other side: the same shift, mirrored. var least_x: f32 = floatMax(f32); for (0..s.original.clip.frame_count) |frame| { least_x = @min(least_x, s.original.clip.pose(frame)[0]); } s.offset_m = s.layout.least_gap_m - least_x; s.clip_gap_m = 0; for (0..s.original.clip.frame_count) |frame| { poseAt(s, frame); s.clip_gap_m = @max(s.clip_gap_m, mirrorGap(s)); } s.frame = 0; showFrame(s, 0); } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { s.* = .{ .gpa = gpa, .font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, roboto_mono_ttf, 16), .ui_host = undefined, .cam = z.OrbitCamera.init(vec(0.0, 0.9, 0), 4.2), .cube = try z.genMeshCube(gpa, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0), .sphere = try z.genMeshSphere(gpa, 1.0, 10, 8), .transform = .{zm.identity()}, .doc = undefined, .robot = undefined, .imported = undefined, .partners = undefined, .lowest_points = undefined, .original = undefined, .mirrored = undefined, }; s.ui_host = z.UiHost.init(gpa, s.font); s.cam.yaw = 0.0; s.cam.pitch = 0.25; s.doc = try codecs.xml.parse(gpa, z.robot_geno_model, null); s.robot = try mjcf.readRobot(gpa, &s.doc); const options: rbt.Options = .{ .timestep = 1.0 / 60.0, .gravity = vec(0, 0, -9.81) }; s.imported = try rmj.build(gpa, &s.robot, options); const model: *const rbt.Model = &s.imported.model; s.partners = try gpa.alloc(u32, model.body_count); for (s.partners, 0..) |*partner, body| { partner.* = partnerOf(s.imported.names, @intCast(body)); } s.lowest_points = try gpa.alloc(f32, model.body_count); s.original.data = try rbt.Data.init(gpa, model); s.mirrored.data = try rbt.Data.init(gpa, model); try loadPair(s, 0); } fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { if (s.loaded_clip >= 0) { s.original.clip.deinit(); s.mirrored.clip.deinit(); } s.mirrored.data.deinit(); s.original.data.deinit(); gpa.free(s.lowest_points); gpa.free(s.partners); s.imported.deinit(); s.robot.deinit(); s.doc.deinit(); z.unloadMesh(gpa, s.sphere); z.unloadMesh(gpa, s.cube); s.ui_host.deinit(); z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } fn drawPanel(s: *State, f: *z.Frame) bool { const u: ui.Ui = s.ui_host.begin(f); const captured: bool = u.wantCaptureMouse(); if (u.window("Geno's clips, mirrored", .{ .initial_pos = .{ 4, 4 }, .initial_size = .{ 390, 340 }, })) |window| { defer window.close(); for (clip_pairs, 0..) |pair, index| { if (index > 0) { u.sameLine(.{}); } _ = u.radioButton(pair.label, &s.clip_index, @intCast(index)); } const frames: f32 = float(s.original.clip.frame_count); u.text("frame {d} of {d}", .{ int(usize, s.frame), s.original.clip.frame_count }); _ = u.slider("frame", &s.frame, .{ .min = 0.0, .max = frames - 1.0, .fmt = "{d:.0}" }); _ = u.slider("frames a second", &s.rate, .{ .min = 2.0, .max = 60.0, .fmt = "{d:.0}" }); _ = u.checkbox("play", &s.playing); u.sameLine(.{}); _ = u.checkbox("follow", &s.follow); u.sameLine(.{}); _ = u.checkbox("soles", &s.show_soles); if (u.button("<", .{})) { s.frame = @max(0.0, s.frame - 1.0); s.playing = false; } u.sameLine(.{}); if (u.button(">", .{})) { s.frame = @min(frames - 1.0, s.frame + 1.0); s.playing = false; } _ = u.radioButton("mirror pair", &s.view, @backingInt(View.mirror_pair)); u.sameLine(.{}); _ = u.radioButton("reflected back", &s.view, @backingInt(View.reflected_back)); // The mirrored left sole is the original right's, and the other way. u.text("soles (m) original mirrored", .{}); u.text(" left {d:8.4} {d:8.4}", .{ s.original_left.height, s.mirrored_left.height }); u.text(" right {d:8.4} {d:8.4}", .{ s.original_right.height, s.mirrored_right.height }); // How far the mirrored clip's farthest body lies from where its partner was, reflected. u.text("mirror gap: {e:.1} m (the clip: {e:.1} m)", .{ s.frame_gap_m, s.clip_gap_m }); } return captured; } /// The robot's shapes on a posed clip, moved `shift` along x - each shape where its body puts it. fn drawRobot( s: *State, gl: *z.WgpuGl, data: *const rbt.Data, shift: Vec, tint: Color, ) void { const model: *const rbt.Model = &s.imported.model; const to_y_up: Mat = zm.zUpToYUp(); for (0..model.geom_count) |geom| { const body: u32 = model.geom_body[geom]; if (body == 0) { continue; } const body_turn: Quat = data.body_orientations[body]; const centre: Vec = data.body_positions[body] + rotate(body_turn, model.geom_local_position[geom]) + shift; const geom_turn: Quat = qmul(body_turn, model.geom_local_rotation[geom]); const place: Mat = mulMat(mulMat(to_y_up, translation(centre[0], centre[1], centre[2])), quatToMat(geom_turn)); switch (model.geom_shape[geom]) { .sphere => |sphere| { s.transform[0] = mulMat(place, scaling(sphere.radius, sphere.radius, sphere.radius)); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &s.sphere, &s.transform, tint); }, .box => |box| { const size: Vec = box.half_extent * splat(2.0); s.transform[0] = mulMat(place, scaling(size[0], size[1], size[2])); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &s.cube, &s.transform, tint); }, .capsule => |capsule| { // A capsule lies along its own y: its segment's two ends, drawn y up. const half_axis: Vec = rotate(geom_turn, vec(0, capsule.half_height, 0)); const start: Vec = drawn(centre - half_axis); const end: Vec = drawn(centre + half_axis); z.drawCapsule(gl, start, end, capsule.radius, 12, 6, tint); }, else => {}, } } } /// A posed clip's skeleton: a dot at every body and a line to its parent, each place through `placed`. fn drawSkeleton( s: *State, gl: *z.WgpuGl, data: *const rbt.Data, placed: *const fn (Vec) Vec, tint: Color, ) void { const model: *const rbt.Model = &s.imported.model; for (1..model.body_count) |body| { const here: Vec = drawn(placed(data.body_positions[body])); z.drawSphereWires(gl, here, .{ .radius = s.layout.joint_radius_m, .rings = 4, .slices = 6, .color = tint }); const parent: u32 = model.body_parent[body]; if (parent == 0) { continue; } z.drawLine3D(gl, here, drawn(placed(data.body_positions[parent])), tint); } } fn unchanged(place: Vec) Vec { return place; } /// A sole that is down: a flat marker under its foot. fn drawSole(s: *State, gl: *z.WgpuGl, sole: Sole, shift: Vec) void { if (sole.height > s.layout.down_height_m) { return; } const at: Vec = sole.at + shift; const place: Mat = mulMat(zm.zUpToYUp(), translation(at[0], at[1], 0.004)); s.transform[0] = mulMat(place, scaling(0.16, 0.16, 0.008)); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &s.cube, &s.transform, s.palette.sole_down); } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { if (s.clip_index != s.loaded_clip) { const index: usize = @intCast(s.clip_index); loadPair(s, index) catch { s.clip_index = s.loaded_clip; }; } const frames: f32 = float(s.original.clip.frame_count); if (s.playing) { const usable_delta: bool = f.time.delta_time > 0 and f.time.delta_time < 0.2; const dt: f32 = if (usable_delta) f.time.delta_time else 0.0; s.frame += dt * s.rate; if (s.frame >= frames) { s.frame = 0; } } showFrame(s, int(usize, clamp(s.frame, 0.0, frames - 1.0))); z.clearViewport(f, s.palette.background); defer s.ui_host.render(f); const captured: bool = drawPanel(s, f); const view: View = @fromBackingInt(@intCast(s.view)); if (s.follow) { // Side by side, the pair's middle is on the mirror plane: follow the original's root along it. Reflected // back, follow the original's root itself. const root: Vec = s.original.data.body_positions[1]; const across: f32 = if (view == .mirror_pair) 0 else root[0]; s.cam.target = drawn(vec(across - s.layout.view_shift_m, root[1], 0.9)); } const cam: Camera3D = s.cam.update(f, captured, .{ .min_distance = 1.0, .max_distance = 12.0 }); const gl = f.gl; z.beginMode3D(gl, cam); z.drawGrid(gl, 40, 0.25); s.transform[0] = mulMat(mulMat(zm.zUpToYUp(), translation(0, 0, -0.5)), scaling(30, 30, 0.2)); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &s.cube, &s.transform, s.palette.ground); switch (view) { .mirror_pair => { // The original moved off the plane one way, the mirrored clip as far the other: each the other's // reflection, and the plane between them drawn as a line on the floor. const shift: Vec = vec(s.offset_m, 0, 0); const mirrored_shift: Vec = vec(-s.offset_m, 0, 0); drawRobot(s, gl, &s.original.data, shift, s.palette.original); drawRobot(s, gl, &s.mirrored.data, mirrored_shift, s.palette.mirrored); const plane_half_length: f32 = 15.0; z.drawLine3D(gl, vec(0, 0.002, -plane_half_length), vec(0, 0.002, plane_half_length), s.palette.mirror); if (s.show_soles) { drawSole(s, gl, s.original_left, shift); drawSole(s, gl, s.original_right, shift); drawSole(s, gl, s.mirrored_left, mirrored_shift); drawSole(s, gl, s.mirrored_right, mirrored_shift); } }, .reflected_back => { // Both skeletons where the original stands: the mirrored clip's reflected back across the plane, so // that a right mirror draws one skeleton. drawSkeleton(s, gl, &s.original.data, &unchanged, s.palette.original); drawSkeleton(s, gl, &s.mirrored.data, &acrossTheMirror, s.palette.mirrored); }, } z.endMode3D(gl); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - Geno's clips, mirrored", .width = 1100, .height = 640, .scale_mode = .responsive, .depth_format = .depth24_plus, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
